app.name: Handball AI
app.tagline: Upload the video, everything else happens automatically.
app.description: Match report, clips, statistics, plays and insights from every match video. No manual tagging.

home.foundation: In 5 minutes: create club, team and roster. Match analysis follows milestone by milestone.
home.courtLabel: Handball court 40 × 20 m, drawn from the shared geometry

auth.name: Full name
auth.terms: I accept the terms of use and the privacy policy.
auth.oauthTerms: By continuing you accept the terms of use and the privacy policy.

auth.verifyOk: Thanks, your e-mail address is confirmed.

onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.clubIntro: Create your club. You can change logo and colours later.
onboarding.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 1 MB.
onboarding.teamIntro: Which team do you analyse first?
onboarding.youth: Youth team (parental consent needed, players do not see team statistics)
onboarding.rosterIntro: Enter your roster by hand or upload a CSV file.
onboarding.inviteIntro: Invite fellow coaches and players. You can also do this later.

roster.title: Roster
roster.empty: No players in the roster yet.
roster.emptyHint: Add players one by one or import a CSV file.
roster.csvHint: Columns: first_name; last_name; number; position; hand; birth_year. Separator ; or ,
roster.csvImported: {count, plural, one {# player imported} other {# players imported}}.

settings.title: Settings
settings.twoFactorOn: Active. Signing in also needs a code from your authenticator app.
settings.twoFactorOff: Not active. Club admins must enable it after 14 days.
settings.twoFactorRequired: As a club admin you must enable two-factor sign-in.
settings.twoFactorScan: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, 1Password) or enter the key manually.

account.title: Account
account.emailUnverified: Your e-mail address is not confirmed yet.
account.setPasswordIntro: You sign in without a password so far. You can set one here.
account.passwordChanged: Password saved. Other devices were signed out.

matches.title: Matches
matches.emptyHint: Create a match and upload the video. Analysis starts automatically.
matches.kitsHint: Colours help the analysis tell the teams apart.
matches.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete the match with all videos and data?

upload.title: Upload video
upload.drop: Drop a video here or choose one
upload.failed: Upload failed. Choose the same file to continue.
upload.paused: Paused. Choose the same file again to continue.
upload.linkHint: Direct link to a video file, e.g. a download link from Veo or Spiideo.
upload.tips: One fixed camera, raised (3 m or more), at the centre line, whole court in view. At least 1080p; in halls with 50 Hz lighting use 50 or 100 fps.

quality.title: Video quality
quality.not_evaluated: checked once court detection is available
quality.tip_resolution_low: Film in 1080p or 4K so jersey numbers are readable.
quality.tip_resolution_too_low: Resolution too low. Film at least in 1080p.
quality.tip_fps_low: With 50 fps fast shots are detected better.
quality.tip_fps_too_low: Frame rate too low. Use 50 fps.
quality.tip_duration_short: The video is short. Upload the whole match for a match analysis.
quality.tip_too_dark: The image is dark. Increase exposure.
quality.tip_too_bright: The image is overexposed. Reduce exposure.
quality.tip_flicker: The image flickers. In halls with 50 Hz light film with 50 or 100 fps.
quality.tip_camera_moving: The camera moves a lot. Use a tripod and fix it.
quality.tip_blurry: The image is blurry. Lock the focus on the court.
